idea-plugin.name: Zee
idea-plugin.description: Zee language: TextMate syntax for .zee files and the same zee lsp contract as VS Code / Cursor (hover, complete, go to definition, diagnostics, semantic tokens). Requires LSP4IJ and the Zee CLI on PATH.

server.name: Zee Language Server
server.description: Runs zee lsp. Install the Zee CLI on PATH (npm link from zee-lang).
